ns2:course.label: Literature Seminar in Math
ns2:course.description: Seminar on topics of current interest in mathematics. Students present seminars and discussions on various topics. See Class Schedule for current topics. Recommended for all Mathematics students. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
